name: Ancient Stoneslab 1
flavor: We discovered an ancient stoneslab written in old scriptures. It appears to say something about Halls of Legends.
hint: You don't know what this is yet.

name: Fossilized Piece of Bark 1
flavor: We discovered a fossilized piece of bark with the image of a Faction Coin carved into it.
hint: You don't know what this is yet.

name: Bone Fragment 1
flavor: We discovered a sundial shaped artifact, probably made of animal bones.
hint: You don't know what this is yet.

name: Ancient Stoneslab 2
flavor: We discovered an ancient stoneslab written in old scriptures. We can recognize the number 300.
hint: You don't know what this is yet.

name: Fossilized Piece of Bark 2
flavor: We discovered a fossilized piece of bark with the symbol of One Million.
hint: You don't know what this is yet.

name: Bone Fragment 2
flavor: We discovered an artifact shaped like the number 36, probably made of animal bones.
hint: You don't know what this is yet.

name: Key to the Lost City
flavor: Despite being thousands of years old, it's still shiny.
hint: You don't know what this is yet.

name: Ancient Device
flavor: This strange device seems to react to the Ancient Races magical capabilities... We may channel its power to increase their research potential!
hint: You don't know what this is yet.
requirements: Requires one of: upgrade "Olympian Hall", upgrade "Stonehenge", upgrade "Sunken City"

name: Earth Core
flavor: This piece of molten rock is continuously shifting its shape, responding to mysterious energy sources.
hint: You don't know what this is yet.

name: Horn of the Kings
flavor: It is said that when this horn is blown, the voices of past Dwarven Kings can be heard in the wind.
hint: You don't know what this is yet.

name: Flame of Bondelnar
flavor: The magical azure flame of Bondelnar constantly emanates a silent, yet subtle, evil aura.
hint: You don't know what this is yet.

name: Rough Stone
flavor: A common, totally uninteresting stone.
hint: A first-time only discovery.

name: Scarab of Fortune
flavor: You found the rarest of relics. This golden scarab will grant you 7 days of good luck, starting from now. Make good use of it!
hint: Rarely found in the pyramids of old.

name: Chocolate Cookie
flavor: Found in a wasteland made of cakes and sweets, snatched from the hands of an old woman...
hint: Excavated commonly in all areas.

name: Fossilized Rodent
flavor: What's this, a prehistoric mouse...?
hint: Hello, mouse.

name: Power Orb
flavor: Throbbing with arcane power.
hint: Attracted by massive concentration of mana.

name: Pink Carrot
flavor: The main product of properly nurtured Farms.
hint: Found randomly in the Farms.

name: Bottled Voice
flavor: The essence of a melodic Fairy voice.
hint: Can be captured when Chanting.

name: Lucky Clover
flavor: A perfectly shaped four-leaf clover. Each leaf is almost unnaturally identical to the other three.
hint: Requires extreme amounts of luck!

name: Mini-treasure
flavor: It's a small perfect replica of the old gold-filled treasure.
hint: Click your way to the treasure!

name: Pillar Fragment
flavor: A tiny piece of the legendary pillars which sustain all the Heavens.
hint: May fall from the Heavens.

name: Divine Sword
flavor: The shining golden sword of an Archangel. Its hilt feels pleasantly warm to the pure of heart, and burning hot for the villain.
hint: Only found by dedicated Angel allies.

name: Ancient Coin Piece
flavor: A common goblin lucky charm. The older it is, the luckier you are, or so they say.
hint: Rarely found among other special coins.

name: Goblin Purse
flavor: Heavy and roomy. Definitely too big for just pocket change.
hint: Fill your pockets with extorted money.

name: Rotten Organ
flavor: Ew... disgusting. It still pulses.
hint: Found among large masses of dead bodies.

name: Jaw Bone
flavor: A jaw, missing more than half of its teeth.
hint: Needs some time in the night.

name: Demonic Figurine
flavor: An intricate figurine representing the evil face of a lesser demon.
hint: Look for the trophies of the beast.

name: Demon Horn
flavor: Still blazing with the flames of Hell. Handle with care.
hint: Only found by dedicated Demon allies.

name: Huge Titan Statue
flavor: The granite representation of a giant wielding a lightning bolt in its fist. A foot appears to be missing.
hint: Struck by the lightning.

name: Titan Shield
flavor: A gargantuan metal shield, twice as tall as a common human.
hint: Don't fret it.

name: Glyph Table
flavor: Contains all the secrets of the Druidic Alphabet.
hint: Balance your buildings.

name: Stone of Balance
flavor: A carved stone hovering above its pedestal.
hint: A Grand Balance performance.

name: Translucent Goo
flavor: A completely odorless sticky substance with a diaphanous, unsettling glow.
hint: Byproduct of the Brain.

name: Octopus-shaped Helmet
flavor: A large helmet with empty metal prongs to accomodate tentacular appendages.
hint: Found in the Labyrinths.

name: Dwarven Bow
flavor: Actually a heavy throwing hammer.
hint: Click to throw.

name: Stone Tankard
flavor: A very heavy mug for drinking the heaviest of beers.
hint: Found in the Inns.

name: Ceremonial Dagger
flavor: Its blade is unnaturally keen and sharp.
hint: Avoid hurting your fingers.

name: Arachnid Figurine
flavor: If you are afraid of spiders, Drow aren't your faction.
hint: Embrace Evil. For a while.

name: Steel Plate
flavor: A full plate made of hardened steel.
hint: Legacy from 50 generations ago.

name: Black Sword
flavor: A long sword with an extremely sharp blade made of dark metal.
hint: Only found by really, really dedicated Mercenary allies.

name: Dragon Fang
flavor: This huge fang can barely fit in the hands of a Titan.
hint: Found in the Wyrm Dens.

name: Dragon Soul
flavor: The extracted soul from an ancient dragon, wields the power to end the world in an instant. Also makes a good soup ingredient.
hint: Take five deep breaths.

name: Vanilla Flavor Juice
flavor: An essence from extremely savory vanilla beans.
hint: Quickly!

name: Ancient Cocoa Bean
flavor: Despite being centuries old, it still smells like top-quality cocoa.
hint: True Neutral Flavor.

name: Know Your Enemy, Part I
flavor: All the knowledge you need stored in a handy book.
hint: A true Mercenary should learn by all other cultures.

name: Voodoo Doll
flavor: You are now CURSED! And you feel a sting in your lower rear.
hint: Found in the Witch Conclaves.

name: Wall Fragment
flavor: A fragment of an utterly and completely unbreakable wall. Enjoy your paradox.
hint: Ascension...

name: Spiky Rough Egg
flavor: What a weird egg... it looks ages old, yet something alive is inside. Perhaps if you wait long enough, something will hatch?
hint: You don't know what this is yet.

name: Fortune Teller Machine
flavor: A devilish star gazes upon your future. Is this a good or a bad sign...?
hint: Don't choose your allies until you know more.

name: Dawnstone
flavor: Only found during sunrise hours. Emits a faint glow.
hint: Relic of the Dawn hours.

name: Duskstone
flavor: Only found during sunset hours. Absorbs light in a small radius.
hint: Relic of the Dusk hours.

name: Ancient Heirloom
flavor: Passed down countless generations.
hint: Relic of the Lineage.

name: Obsidian Shard
flavor: Extremely hard and black as darkness itself, this material cannot apparently be carved or melted. It is a mystery how you can make this thing into a sword.
hint: You don't know what this is yet.

name: Know Your Enemy, Part II
flavor: Much more knowledge than you need, stored in a handy book.
hint: Even an expert Mercenary should learn by all other cultures.

name: Veteran Figurine
flavor:
The warrior of a thousand battles, ultimate champion of the Realms.

Passive effect: allows Mercenaries to benefit from all faction challenges.
hint: A reward for the veteran challenger.

name: Wall Chunk
flavor: A bigger piece of the infamous Ascension Wall.
hint: More Ascension...

name: Excavated Mirage
flavor: You know all too well this does not exist, yet it fills you with hope and optimism.
hint: Raise your chances.

name: Ancestral Hourglass
flavor: The silver sands contained within seem to never stop flowing.
hint: Really, raise your chances.

name: Silk Cloth
flavor: The purest silk made for Fairies, by Fairies, of Fairies.
hint: Found in the Swarming Towers.

name: Raw Emerald
flavor: Just slightly less precious than a raw Ruby.
hint: Not found on the first Excavation round.

name: Fossilized Wing
flavor: The remains of an Angel fallen to earth.
hint: Angels may fall after a long time.

name: Spiked Whip
flavor: Use with caution. You do not want to exterminate all your slaves.
hint: Used by the overseers in the Slave Markets.

name: Dusty Coffin
flavor: Sealed since forever, yet you can hear a strange noise from within.
hint: The undead have patience.

name: Crystallized Lava
flavor: Incandescent but still. Can be used efficiently as a desk lamp.
hint: Found in the Burning Abysses.

name: Titan Helmet
flavor: Made of enough metal to craft a human-sized full plate.
hint: Found in the trade route used for Exchanges.

name: Branch of the Life Tree
flavor: Despite being torn from its source tree, it keeps growing buds and leaves.
hint: Found in the remains of druidic ancestors.

name: Nightmare Figment
flavor: An unshaped, ephemeral substance which is politely trying to corrupt your mind.
hint: A strong and quick brain is required.

name: Beard Hair
flavor: Hopefully coming from a real dwarven beard.
hint: It requires a lot of beard samples to get the perfect hair.

name: Poison Vial
flavor: One drop of this is enough to fell thousands of non-immune creatures.
hint: Combo your way through.

name: Dragon Scale
flavor: Very high on the realms' most accurate hardiness rankings.
hint: Usually found when a lot of magic is lingering.

name: Lantern of Guidance
flavor: Follow the guiding light, o wanderer, for it shall bring you fortune.
hint: Massive mana flows can offer guidance.

name: Oil Lamp
flavor: Rub it, polish it. And remember to express your desires precisely, lest you want to face dire consequences.
hint: Chaos magic burns brightly.

name: Spark of Life
flavor: The spark of Creation, dimly shining from the bottom of its encasing crystal.
hint: The power of Creation may spark something new.

flavor: It looks like a piece of an iron object. It's broken off on two sides.

flavor: Intricate leylines of mana cover the surface of this stone, moving and flailing endlessly to create ever-different patterns.

Used to weave even the thinnest mana strings.
